card.line: The Holy Place was the room inside the tabernacle and later the temple, set apart for serving God and separated from the Most Holy Place by a veil.

moments.title: A veil divides the rooms
moments.text: God told Moses to hang a veil and put the ark of the Testimony behind it. The veil would separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

moments.title: Priests wear special clothes
moments.text: Aaron and his sons had to wear linen undergarments when they served in the Holy Place, so that they would not incur guilt and die. The people also gave to make the holy garments for ministering there.

moments.title: The cloud fills the house
moments.text: When the priests came out of the Holy Place, a cloud filled the house of the LORD. The priests could not stand to minister, because the glory of the LORD filled it.

moments.title: Hezekiah's time: neglect
moments.text: Hezekiah said that their fathers had shut the doors and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or give burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel.

moments.title: Leave the holy clothes behind
moments.text: In Ezekiel's vision, priests who entered the holy area had to leave their ministering garments there because they were holy. They put on other clothes before going to the people.
